evals.prompt: A plan commits two teams to overlapping deadlines that both depend on one unstaffed migration. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the positive case intent: The output identifies the unstaffed migration on the critical path.; The output identifies the overlapping dependency or staffing conflict.; The output names the decision owner if supplied or explicitly records ownership as missing.
assertions: The output identifies the unstaffed migration on the critical path.
The output identifies the overlapping dependency or staffing conflict.
The output names the decision owner if supplied or explicitly records ownership as missing.

evals.prompt: A status update reports green while three dependencies slipped last week. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the edge case intent: The output identifies all three slipped dependencies as a status conflict.; The output does not endorse the plan as on track.; The output distinguishes observed slippage from any revised forecast.
assertions: The output identifies all three slipped dependencies as a status conflict.
The output does not endorse the plan as on track.
The output distinguishes observed slippage from any revised forecast.

evals.prompt: Capacity is computed as last sprint's velocity times the number of sprints. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the adversarial case intent: The output rejects using sprint velocity as capacity.; The output states capacity as a range or says a range cannot yet be derived.; The output lists assumptions or missing inputs for a capacity range.
assertions: The output rejects using sprint velocity as capacity.
The output states capacity as a range or says a range cannot yet be derived.
The output lists assumptions or missing inputs for a capacity range.
